sources.title: Announcers set for Patriots-Jets Week 11 matchup
highlights:
. ET The announcers have been set for Thursday’s Week 11 contest between the New York Jets and New England Patriots . The legendary Al Michaels will take on the play-by-play, while Kirk Herbstreit will take on the analysis portion. Kaylee Hartung will report from the sideline. It will be a game that features a classic rivalry with the Patriots heavily favored in the matchup. With that said, the Jets have won two of the last three games between the two teams. But both teams look significantly different than they did in those meetings. The Patriots are one of the hottest teams in football with an 8-2 record and riding a seven-game win streak, while the Jets are still trying to find their way with a 2-7 record. New England leads the all-time series by a 75-56-1 count. This is a game where the Patriots will be dealing with an undermanned Jets team that will be missing multiple pieces, such as Sauce Gardner and Quinnen Williams, who were traded to the Indianapolis Colts and Dallas Cowboys, respectively. The Jets' star receiver, Garrett Wilson, is also expected to miss the game with an injury. This could be another opportunity for the Patriots to make a strong statement in the AFC East division.
